source_note: Incompetech (Kevin MacLeod), CC BY 4.0. Cleared for commercial use including monetised YouTube; the attribution line must appear in the description of every video using the track. Chosen at KT2 over Pixabay and the YouTube Audio Library because one author under one clear licence keeps the Content ID risk low.
mood_note: The mood tags come from measured features - event density, spectral brightness and dynamic ratio over a minute from the middle of each track - not from listening. They are a defensible starting point, not a substitute for an ear.
fetch_note: The mp3s are not in the repository, which holds code only. They are fetched from these URLs on the runner and cached against this file's hash.

tracks.title: Echoes of Time v2
tracks.character: a dark insistent pulse, 17 events a minute with the energy low in the spectrum

tracks.title: Long Note Four
tracks.character: almost no event at all - 2 a minute - and dark: a drone that sits under explanation

tracks.title: Dark Times
tracks.character: slow and even, 3 events a minute, mid spectrum: foreboding without movement

tracks.title: Impact Andante
tracks.character: the brightest in the library by a wide margin and very steady: scale and aftermath

tracks.title: Ossuary 6 - Air
tracks.character: airy and sparse, 7 events a minute: room left for numbers and evidence

tracks.title: Deep Haze
tracks.character: a busy but very even texture, the least dynamic of all: momentum without accents

tracks.title: Ghost Processional
tracks.character: the most strongly accented track here, dark and processional: something arriving

tracks.title: Lightless Dawn
tracks.character: the busiest, 51 events a minute, and dark with it: events in sequence
